name: Rat Catching

angles.text: As defenders of Khaz Modan, Dwarves have a direct stake in keeping the foothills around Thelsamar clear of vermin and subterranean invaders.
Mountaineer Kadrell speaks for Loch Modan's local dwarven authorities. He offers bounties to Alliance travelers willing to safeguard their settlements.

faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell offers the bounty in Thelsamar. He asks travelers to cull the vermin coming from the nearby mountainside.
faq.q: Who gives the Rat Catching quest?

faq.answer: Tunnel rat kobolds are a breed of kobolds that have dug dens in the western foothills near Thelsamar. They foul the mountainside.
Tunnel rat kobolds and their dens lie directly west of Thelsamar, scattered along the mountainside and foothills.
faq.q: Where can the tunnel rat kobolds be found?

faq.answer: Mountaineer Kadrell asks for tunnel rat ears as proof of the kill before paying the town's bounty.
faq.q: Why does Kadrell ask for Tunnel Rat Ears?

aliases: why kill kobolds in loch modan
faq.answer: The kobolds have moved into the foothills outside Thelsamar, where they make dens and foul the surrounding dwarven lands. Kadrell wants them driven out to secure the area.
faq.q: Why is the Mountaineer concerned about the kobold infestation?

aliases: does rat catching have follow up
faq.answer: This is a local bounty to clear pests around Thelsamar. Kadrell pays once the ears are delivered.
faq.q: Does Rat Catching lead to a larger questline?

sections.body: West of Thelsamar, tunnel rat kobolds have made dens in the foothills of Loch Modan. They foul the surrounding ground and trouble the roads leading into town. Their warrens threaten the safety and cleanliness of those roads.
sections.title: Vermin in the Foothills

sections.body: Mountaineer Kadrell has set a bounty on the tunnel rat kobolds. He asks passing travelers to bring their severed ears as proof of the cull. Then he pays coin and compensation, though the trophies are foul to inspect.
sections.title: A Mountaineer's Bounty

summary: In the western foothills, tunnel rat kobolds trouble the roads into Thelsamar. Mountaineer Kadrell calls on travelers to drive them back and bring proof of the cull for a bounty.
